content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To drink from sippy cup, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Check for any cracks in the plastic cup body (10 seconds)
Step 2. Align the internal valve with the lid opening (15 seconds)
Step 3. Shake the cup to test for leaks (5 seconds)
Step 4. Locate the silicone spout (5 seconds)
Step 5. Gather all disassembled cup components (30 seconds)
Step 6. Rinse the cup lid under warm water (20 seconds)
Step 7. Select the appropriate beverage (45 seconds)
Step 8. Dry the exterior of the cup (30 seconds)
Step 9. Inspect the rubber gasket for mold (15 seconds)
Step 10. Screw the lid onto the cup base (10 seconds)
Step 11. Remove the protective travel cap (5 seconds)
Step 12. Wash the cup base with soapy water (1 minute)
Step 13. Snap the spout into the lid (10 seconds)
Step 14. Check the flow rate of the spout (5 seconds)
Step 15. Place the cup on a flat surface (5 seconds)
Step 16. Sanitize the cup handles (2 minutes)
Step 17. Retrieve the drying rack (20 seconds)
Step 18. Attach the handles to the cup base (10 seconds)
Step 19. Pour the beverage into the cup (15 seconds)
Step 20. Measure the temperature of the liquid (10 seconds)
Step 21. Wipe away any condensation (10 seconds)
Step 22. Find the cup in the kitchen cabinet (30 seconds)
Step 23. Fill the cup with ice cubes (10 seconds)
Step 24. Ensure the lid is level (5 seconds)
Step 25. Position the cup for the toddler (5 seconds)
Step 26. Clean the straw attachment if applicable (1 minute)
Step 27. Tighten the lid to ensure a seal (5 seconds)
Step 28. Inspect the cup for soap residue (15 seconds)
Step 29. Offer the cup to the child (5 seconds)
Step 30. Watch the child take the first sip (10 seconds)
Step 31. Set the lid aside to dry (5 minutes)
Step 32. Open the refrigerator (5 seconds)
Step 33. Organize the cabinet shelves (10 minutes)
Step 34. Hand the cup to the toddler (5 seconds)
Step 35. Prepare the high chair area (2 minutes)
Step 36. Locate the cleaning brush (10 seconds)
Step 37. Inspect the air vent hole (5 seconds)
Step 38. Check that the spout is centered (5 seconds)
Step 39. Lift the cup to mouth level (3 seconds)
Step 40. Clear the table of obstacles (1 minute)
Step 41. Verify the drink is not too hot (5 seconds)
Step 42. Get a paper towel (10 seconds)
Step 43. Place the cup in a cup holder (5 seconds)
Step 44. Tip the cup back to drink (5 seconds)
Step 45. Scrub the inside of the spout (30 seconds)
Step 46. Rinse the gasket (10 seconds)
Step 47. Adjust the child's grip on the handles (5 seconds)
Step 48. Check the weight of the cup (2 seconds)
Step 49. Swallow the liquid (2 seconds)
Step 50. Remove the lid for a refill (10 seconds)
Step 51. Enter the kitchen (5 seconds)
Step 52. Close the refrigerator door (3 seconds)
Step 53. Wipe the child's chin (5 seconds)
Step 54. Inspect the cup for bite marks (10 seconds)
Step 55. Encourage the child to hold it with both hands (5 seconds)
Step 56. Move the kitchen chair (15 seconds)
Step 57. Check the liquid level (2 seconds)
Step 58. Choose a flavor of juice (20 seconds)
Step 59. Put on an apron (30 seconds)
Step 60. Position the bib on the child (20 seconds)
Step 61. Clean the countertop (2 minutes)
Step 62. Fetch a clean sponge (15 seconds)
Step 63. Secure the spill-proof valve (10 seconds)
Step 64. Adjust the spout angle (5 seconds)
Step 65. Sit the child down (1 minute)
Step 66. Store the extra lids (2 minutes)
Step 67. Dilute the juice with water (15 seconds)
Step 68. Select a colorful cup (10 seconds)
Step 69. Remove the safety seal from the juice (10 seconds)
Step 70. Say "Cheers!" (2 seconds)
Step 71. Put the cup back down (2 seconds)
Step 72. Check for leaks around the rim (10 seconds)
Step 73. Soak the lid in hot water (5 minutes)
Step 74. Double check the lid's tightness (5 seconds)
Step 75. Shake off excess water (5 seconds)
Step 76. Finish the drink (10 minutes)
Step 77. Grab the juice carton (5 seconds)
Step 78. Enjoy the refreshment (30 seconds)
Step 79. Tap the bottom of the cup (2 seconds)
Step 80. Clear the sink of dishes (5 minutes)
Step 81. Recycle the empty juice carton (10 seconds)
Step 82. Inspect the valve for tears (15 seconds)
Step 83. Check the expiration date on the juice (10 seconds)
Step 84. Wipe the rim of the cup (5 seconds)
Step 85. Throw away the juice seal (5 seconds)
Step 86. Unscrew the travel ring (5 seconds)
Step 87. Sort the sippy cup parts by color (1 minute)
Step 88. Pour out any excess foam (5 seconds)
Step 89. Peel back the juice label (5 seconds)
Step 90. Press the valve into the lid (10 seconds)
